title: Chapter 272: He's Not Ol' Wong!
html:
“Uncle Wong?” Gu Feiyu glanced at the phone and answered without hesitation. “I’m here. What’s wrong?”

“A resident saw someone suspicious enter Building Three. We’re short-staffed. If you’re still awake, can you come help?”

“Someone suspicious? All right, I’ll be there shortly!” Guilt over Uncle Wong’s lost wages had tormented Xiao Gu. Eager for a chance to make amends, he agreed immediately.

Phone in hand, Gu Feiyu ran to Fang Hwa Apartments. Building Three stood beside the rear gate. He glanced into the guard post and found its door open; Uncle Wong had apparently left in a great hurry.

“Has something already happened?” He called Uncle Wong but received no answer. After entering Building Three, another WeChat message arrived. “The intruder appears to be a thief. We cornered him on the twenty-third floor. Be careful when you arrive.”

“All right.” Worried for Uncle Wong, Xiao Gu rushed into the elevator and selected the twenty-third floor. As the doors closed, he frowned at the phone.

Uncle Wong types slowly and normally sends voice messages. Why didn’t he answer my call?The details confused Xiao Gu, but he did not suspect a trap. I only came to the city for work. I have neither money nor looks; no one has a reason to deceive me. Perhaps they’re watching the thief and cannot risk speaking.

The numbers climbed, and the elevator soon reached the twenty-third floor. “Uncle, I’m here. Where are you?”

Xiao Gu slipped silently from the elevator, concealed himself around a corner, and messaged Uncle Wong for his location.

“The thief entered Room 3239. We’re hiding in the apartment across the hall. Approach quietly.”

Xiao Gu looked down the dark corridor, committed the number to memory, and advanced. His phone provided the only light. Closed doors lined both sides, and his pace gradually slowed.

As he moved farther from the elevator, Xiao Gu looked back. The floor display changed; someone had either summoned or entered the car, which descended to the first floor. If danger appeared now, escape by elevator would be impossible. The car would need at least a minute to return.

Is someone coming up from the first floor? The other guard?Xiao Gu waited, but the elevator did not move. Suspicion stirred. Before he could consider it, Uncle Wong began urging him onward through WeChat.

Alarm bells sounded in Xiao Gu’s mind.

Uncle Wong cannot type this quickly. Someone else is sending these messages.

Xiao Gu had sensed something wrong earlier but dismissed it because he owned nothing worth stealing. Of all Uncle Wong’s contacts, why had the sender chosen him?

Xiao Gu slowed and called Uncle Wong again. No answer. “They keep messaging but refuse the call… because they need to hide their voice?”

Not long ago, Xiao Gu had encountered the madwoman in Building Three and narrowly escaped murder. The experience left a deep scar—and taught him that caution could save his life. He stopped advancing and edged back toward the elevator.

I need to leave and get the other guards.Xiao Gu regretted entering alone. Only hours ago, Uncle Wong had warned him against recklessness. Keeping close to the wall, he retreated along the eerie corridor, his unease mounting.

The elevator is still on the first floor. If no one called it, why did it descend? Did someone enter on this floor while I wasn’t looking?

His phone vibrated in the silent corridor, nearly making him jump. Another message from Uncle Wong appeared. “Have you arrived?”

Panic seized Xiao Gu, and he retreated faster. After several meters, another message arrived. “Are you there?”

Xiao Gu stopped replying. Reaching the elevator, he struck the call button. The car began climbing from the first floor. He watched the display with a pounding heart. The sender seemed to sense his retreat; messages arrived faster and faster, his phone vibrating continuously with the same question.

“Are you there?”

“Are you there?”

“Are you there?”

Xiao Gu no longer doubted that someone else held Uncle Wong’s phone.

Terror grew with every thought. Messages filled the screen, and cold swept through his body. What is happening?

When the elevator reached the eleventh floor, the messages abruptly stopped. Xiao Gu exhaled and wiped his forehead, finding it drenched in cold sweat. Someone took Uncle Wong’s phone. I must leave before they find me.

Xiao Gu jabbed the call button repeatedly. As the elevator passed the fourteenth floor, he looked over his shoulder. A door at the far end creaked open, and a pale figure holding Uncle Wong’s phone leaned its head into the corridor.

…

“My parents raised me to obey the law. They gave me a strong sense of justice and taught me to help others whenever possible. When I saw people breaking the law and threatening innocent visitors, I had to stop them. I admit emotion influenced me, but the situation offered no alternative. Had I hesitated, more people would have been injured.”

Chen Ge rattled his handcuffs as he delivered the statement to Captain Yan and the three officers seated across the interrogation table.

“And that justifies beating them unconscious?” The officer beside Captain Yan frowned.

“But I’m the victim. They outnumbered me.”

“Have you ever seen a victim file a report while delivering two unconscious suspects?”

“They attacked me first; I was only acting in self-defense.”

Chen Ge stared at the four officers, and they stared back. At last, Captain Yan coughed. “Enough. The officers verifying your account should return shortly.”
